description: One confidence-weighted trust verdict for a domain, URL or email: runs linkcheck, sitegrade and domain-intel (plus email-verify when an email is supplied) and flags disagreement between sources, such as a very new domain with a mature TLS setup, instead of concatenating outputs. At least one of domain, url or email is required. Costs $0.10 per call via x402.

domain.description: Domain to audit. Required if url and email are both omitted.

email.description: Email address to audit. Optional in addition to domain/url.

url.description: URL to audit. Required if domain and email are both omitted.

name: tariffmonkee-trust-audit
